method.broadband: Smallest local transient excess across three bands between 2200 and 7900 Hz.
method.decision: One strict control-maximum point per arm, pooled across scenes. Fit on distinct development readers. Advance an editing observation only with at least three useful held edits across at least two noisy scenes, at most one flagged no-local-edit source group and zero flagged isolated backgrounds. A located ordinary splice counts as an editing observation, and rules out treating that result as AI evidence.
method.edge_band: Larger local transient excess in the below-90 Hz and uppermost measured bands.
method.mixing: Original and publisher variant retain their earlier exact samples. Independently reduce gain on a constructed control only when needed to prevent clipping. No clips or labels are provided to the two measurements.
method.peak: Hann-window measured band level over the louder 80th percentile flank, floored at -84 dBFS. Require two endpoints 160 to 1200 ms apart. The weaker endpoint sets the pair score.
